(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS Land Acquisition Notices

AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) UNDER THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT No.28 OF 1964 Notice under Section 7 My Ref: MOR/LAN/01/F1/204. Land Ministry No.: 4-3/4/2016/CR/54. I hereby give public notice, under sub section 1 of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act. No.28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is called Lansiyawatta situated in Modara, Moratuwa for the use of Continuum and Radar station of Waruna institution of the Department of Coast Conservation. Description of the land to be acquired: Allotment of Land in extent of 0.4802 Hectare depicted in sheet No.04 of the block 14 of the Cadastral Map No.520217 dated 31.12.2022 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village called Egodauyana in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Moratuwa in Colombo District of the Western Province described as follows.

My Ref.: MOR/LAN/01/F1/219. Land Ministry No.: 4-3/17/2021/LO/81. In accordance with the provisions of the land acquisition act under sub section 1 of section 7 hereby notified to all concerned that the government intends to acquire the following described land for the purpose of establishing the Egodauyana police station. Description of the land to be acquired: An allotment of Land in measuring 0.1160 Hectare as depicted in Sheet No.19 of Block No. 09 of the Cadastral map No.520217 dated 09.10.2024 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village Egodauyana, within the 556A Egodauyana Central Grama Niladhari Division in the Moratuwa Division in Colombo District, Western Province described as follows.

Lot No.01 Name of the land - Madangahawatta, Currant utilization of the Land – Garden, including 02 permanent buildings, Ownership – Arvin Stannis Bulathsinhala , Extent 0.1160 hectare All persons claiming ownership, interest, or any other connection to the above-mentioned land or domain are hereby required to appear personally, or by authorized agents dully authorized in writing before me on 28.01.2025 at 12.30 p.m. at Moratuwa Divisional Secretariat for inquiry regarding the acquisition. Further, all interested parties are requested to notify, in writing (with two copies), the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount on or before 09.01.2025. All relevant deeds and documents in support of claims should be submitted at the inquiry. S.P. Kංඋංඐൺඍඁඍඁඎൽඎඐൺ Divisional Secretary, Moratuwa. On 27.11.2024 At Divisional Secretariat –Moratuwa.
